Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              zhicheng.chen@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-07-17T10:00:00
-- Description:         risk all region fearure about MP metrics
-- Data Granularity:    
-- PRD                  https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yYtlZE7Di3UiKZ70TUcVkhqp7J2pekSHdG_wmixsqmc/edit?gid=1674787113#gid=1674787113
-- Jira                 https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-49792
--********************************************************************--
${common_head}
WITH user_base AS 
(
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT 
        cast(user_id as string) as platform_user_id
        ,is_phone_verified
        ,datediff('${current_grass_date}', to_date(registration_datetime)) AS shopee_age
        ,case when status = 0 then '0:ACCOUNT_DELETE'
              when status = 1 then '1:ACCOUNT_NORMAL'
              when status = 2 then '2:ACCOUNT_BANNED'
              when status = 3 then '3:ACCOUNT_FROZEN' end as shopee_user_status
    FROM mp_user.dim_user__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}' and grass_date = '${ds}'
)
,active_info AS (
    SELECT cast(user_id as string) AS platform_user_id
        ,MAX(IF(datediff('${ds}',last_login_datetime_td) <= 30, 1, 0)) AS is_a30
        ,MAX(IF(datediff('${ds}',last_login_datetime_td) <= 90, 1, 0)) AS is_a90
        ,MAX(IF(datediff('${ds}',last_login_datetime_td) <= 180, 1, 0)) AS is_a180
        ,MAX(IF(datediff('${ds}',last_login_datetime_td) <= 360, 1, 0)) AS is_a360
    FROM mp_user.ads_activeness_user_activity_td__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}'
          AND grass_date = '${ds}'
        GROUP BY user_id
),
buyer_order_cnt_info as 
(
    select cast(buyer_id as string) as buyer_id,
           paid_order_cnt_1d,
           paid_order_cnt_30d,
           paid_order_cnt_90d,
           paid_order_cnt_180d
    from mp_order.dws_buyer_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = '${REGION}'
        and tz_type = 'local'
        and grass_date = '${ds}'
),
mp_transaction_info as (
   select platform_user_id,
        confirmed_order_l1d,
        confirmed_order_l30d,
        confirmed_order_l90d,
        confirmed_order_l180d,
        confirmed_order_l360d,
        confirmed_order_history,
        nmv_usd_l1d,
        nmv_usd_l30d,
        nmv_usd_l90d,
        nmv_usd_l180d,
        nmv_usd_l360d,
        nmv_usd_history,
        spl_nmv_usd_l1d,
        spl_nmv_usd_l30d,
        spl_nmv_usd_l90d,
        spl_nmv_usd_l180d,
        spl_nmv_usd_l360d,
        spl_nmv_usd_history,
        nmv_usd_l1d*1.0/confirmed_order_l1d as abs_usd_l1d,
        nmv_usd_l30d*1.0/confirmed_order_l30d as abs_usd_l30d,
        nmv_usd_l90d*1.0/confirmed_order_l90d as abs_usd_l90d,
        nmv_usd_l180d*1.0/confirmed_order_l180d as abs_usd_l180d,
        nmv_usd_l360d*1.0/confirmed_order_l360d as abs_usd_l360d,
        nmv_usd_history*1.0/confirmed_order_history as abs_usd_history,
        cod_confirmed_order_l1d*1.0/confirmed_order_l1d as pct_cod_l1d,
        cod_confirmed_order_l30d*1.0/confirmed_order_l30d as pct_cod_l30d,
        cod_confirmed_order_l90d*1.0/confirmed_order_l90d as pct_cod_l90d,
        cod_confirmed_order_l180d*1.0/confirmed_order_l180d as pct_cod_l180d,
        cod_confirmed_order_l360d*1.0/confirmed_order_l360d as pct_cod_l360d,
        cod_confirmed_order_history*1.0/confirmed_order_history as pct_cod_history,
        spl_confirmed_order_l1d,
        spl_confirmed_order_l30d,
        spl_confirmed_order_l90d,
        spl_confirmed_order_l180d,
        max_nmv_usd_l1d,
        max_nmv_usd_l30d,
        max_nmv_usd_l90d,
        max_nmv_usd_l180d,
        cc_nmv_usd_l1d,
        cc_nmv_usd_l30d,
        cc_nmv_usd_l90d,
        cc_nmv_usd_l180d,
        cci_nmv_usd_l1d,
        cci_nmv_usd_l30d,
        cci_nmv_usd_l90d,
